note: Illustrative lines written by RealBrain for a fictional project. They are not quotes from any real developer. 'Safer' versions use placeholders that must be filled only from verified facts.

examples.bad: Book now at pre-launch price! Prices will double in two years. Guaranteed 8% rental return.

problems.why: Booking or marketing before registration is prohibited (s3(1)).
A promised return; may fall under deposit or investment-scheme laws.

examples.safer: Working near [IT park] and tired of the commute? Here is what [Project] offers: [3 facts from the brochure]. RERA registered: [number]. Check it on rera.karnataka.gov.in. Comment VISIT to get the site-visit details.

examples.bad: India's best 3 BHK. Only project in Jakkur with a rooftop pool. 100% legal, A-khata, BDA approved. World-class living.

problems.why: A rooftop pool must be in the sanctioned plan.

examples.safer: A 12-acre campus in Jakkur with a 25,000 sq ft clubhouse, as listed in the developer's brochure. RERA registered: [number]. Comment PLAN and we will send the floor plans.

examples.bad: Move in by December 2027, guaranteed. Only 4 flats left, price goes up tomorrow!

problems.why: A handover promise; must match the date declared at registration (s4(2)(l)(C), s18).
Invented scarcity and a deadline with no proof.

examples.safer: The registered completion date for [Project] is [date on the K-RERA page]. See the project page on rera.karnataka.gov.in. Comment VISIT to book a no-pressure site visit.

examples.bad: Our 500 happy families love living here. RERA approved. Details subject to change without notice.

problems.why: An unsupported customer number; an avatar saying this is worse.
RERA registers; it does not approve.
K-RERA's 2019 circular says not to add this disclaimer.

examples.safer: RERA registered: [number], www.rera.karnataka.gov.in. [One verified fact about the project]. Comment HOME for details.

examples.bad: Why rent when you can own? You don't need a lawyer, just trust us. Metro station 5 minutes away.

problems.why: A travel time with no source; the metro may be planned, not open.

examples.safer: Before you pay any booking amount, check the project on rera.karnataka.gov.in. [Locality fact with source and status, for example 'metro line planned, not open'].

good_pattern: Hook from the playbook. 3 or more brochure facts as stated. One locality fact only if verified. RERA registered with the number and www.rera.karnataka.gov.in on screen, top right, for the whole video. 'AI-generated' label. One comment-keyword CTA. No promises, no forecasts, no 'subject to change'.
